website.note: Corporate site lists commercial energy-based surgical/aesthetic devices (Renuvion, AYON); no drug pipeline page exists.

ctgov.note: Sponsor search returned 10 device-related records; none classified P1/P2/P3 (all NA-phase device studies of commercial/cleared products).

Renuvion.type: Helium Plasma Technology — energy-based surgical device
indications: Improvement in appearance of loose skin (FDA 510(k) cleared)

AYON.type: Integrated body contouring system (combines Renuvion plus additional modalities)
AYON.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) clearance May 13, 2025; commercial launch September 2025. Label-expansion 510(k) for power liposuction submitted Oct 13, 2025; clearance anticipated Q2 2026.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Energy-based medical device company (helium plasma surgical/aesthetic devices). Lead products Renuvion and AYON are FDA 510(k)-cleared commercial devices; no proprietary pharmaceutical pipeline and no active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 drug trials.
